svg.data-weight-note: 22 kg (48.50 lb) fully loaded without optics (guide Table 9)
svg.data-power-measurement-note: Typical and maximum power consumption of the QFX5241-64OD, guide Power System section; the guide gives no test conditions
svg.data-power-input-ac: 200 to 240 VAC, 50 to 60 Hz, 16 A (guide Table 6)
svg.data-power-input-dc: -48 to -60 VDC, 80 A maximum a supply (guide Tables 6 and 17)
svg.data-redundancy-note: two supplies, 1+1, hot-removable and hot-insertable (guide, Component Redundancy)
svg.data-fans: four fan modules of two rotors, N+1 at rotor level; front-to-back only
svg.data-airflow-note: AO is front-to-back (port-to-FRU, airflow out); the guide describes no back-to-front module
svg.data-storage-temp: -40 to 70 C (-40 to 158 F) in the shipping container
svg.data-altitude: no performance degradation to 1828.8 m (6000 ft) at 0 to 40 C with DAC cables; sea level with optics (guide Table 22)
svg.data-cpu: Intel Ice Lake D, 4 cores, 2.2 GHz
svg.data-optics-osfp: 800 GbE OSFP; ports 1, 2, 5, 6, 9, 10 and so on in the two middle rows take high power optics such as 800G-ZR and ZR+ (guide, Ports Panel note)
svg.data-nebs: designed to comply with Zone 4 earthquake requirements of NEBS GR-63-CORE, Issue 3 (guide Table 22)
